prompt.user_template:
I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into stacks. Here are the actions I can do

Pick up a block
Unstack a block from on top of another block
Put down a block
Stack a block on top of another block

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only pick up or unstack one block at a time.
I can only pick up or unstack a block if my hand is empty.
I can only pick up a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not picked up.
I can only unstack a block from on top of another block if the block I am unstacking was really on top of the other block.
I can only unstack a block from on top of another block if the block I am unstacking is clear.
Once I pick up or unstack a block, I am holding the block.
I can only put down a block that I am holding.
I can only stack a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being stacked.
I can only stack a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am stacking the block is clear.
Once I put down or stack a block, my hand becomes empty.
Once you stack a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

[STATEMENT]
{initial_conditions}
{goal}

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.

placeholders.initial_conditions: inside items.query (hook renders the query verbatim)

prompt.source_location: Appendix H.1 '(Solvable) Blocksworld Instances - Zero-Shot in Natural Language'
prompt.verbatim: full (the released zero-shot query text is identical to the printed Appendix H.1 template)

placeholders_prose.initial_conditions: the instance's 'As initial conditions I have that, ...' sentence (last [STATEMENT] block of the repository query)
placeholders_prose.goal: the instance's 'My goal is to have that ...' sentence

output.parse: hook: repository text_to_plan_blocksworld replica (rule-based) -> PDDL actions (primary); parse(strip_star=False) = pre-fix paper version; the gpt-4o translation (side file W4403882451_translation_prompt.txt) is a secondary diagnostic
output.postprocess: lowercase; the resulting plan is written to a file and checked with VAL against the instance PDDL and domain
output.parse_prose: free text; extract action lines matching 'pick up the X block', 'unstack the X block from on top of the Y block', 'put down the X block', 'stack the X block on top of the Y block' (numbering, markdown and explanations ignored) and map them to PDDL (pick-up x), (unstack x y), (put-down x), (stack x y) with the repository's text_to_plan utility

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: fraction of the 600 instances whose extracted plan is valid (every action applicable, goal reached) under the Blocksworld 4-op domain - hook simulator with VAL semantics; it reproduces all 600 released llm_correct flags (241 correct = Table 1) from the released extracted plans
metric.judge: rule (repository text_to_plan_blocksworld replica + Blocksworld simulator = VAL semantics) for the primary number; the gpt-4o translation stage remains available as a secondary diagnostic only (judge_summary.json), it is NOT the paper's path for this cell
metric.original_location: Table 1, Blocksworld / Zero Shot, column GPT-4 Turbo (241/600)
